_catatan: Pustaka efek suara bersama (ElevenLabs Sound Generation), semua track. File di produksi/sfx/el/<nama>.mp3. Buat yang belum ada: node --env-file=.env scripts/produksi/audio-extra.mjs --library

pop.prompt: single soft rounded UI pop, bright bubble tap, very short, clean, no reverb

whoosh.prompt: short smooth airy transition whoosh, soft and clean, no impact

scan.prompt: phone camera QR scan locking on, two quick soft electronic beeps

paid.prompt: warm bright mobile payment success chime, two rising bell notes, friendly

keytap.prompt: single soft smartphone keypad tap, clean, dry

denied.prompt: gentle low error buzz, two short muted tones, not harsh

switch.prompt: small mechanical turntable rotating and clunking into place, satisfying, dry

send.prompt: fast paper envelope zipping along a wire, light digital swish

ping.prompt: soft map marker ping, single clear sonar blip

counter.prompt: rapid soft counting ticks accelerating then a tiny bell, odometer style

shutter.prompt: metal roller shutter pulling down and shutting, short

riser.prompt: subtle suspense riser, low soft tension swell, cinematic, no impact

thud.prompt: soft rounded cartoon thud of a small object landing on wood

moto.prompt: small scooter passing by left to right on a quiet street

seat.prompt: soft cartoon landing thump of someone sitting on a chair

register.prompt: old cash register drawer opening with a bell ding

chime.prompt: warm short success chime, soft bells
